summary: IonQ filed an 8-K disclosing an October 9, 2026 Agreement and Plan of Merger to acquire Elisity, Inc. via merger subsidiary Espresso Acquisition Sub, in an all-stock deal valued at $1.15 billion in IonQ shares, plus up to $150 million earnout tied to Elisity revenue milestones from August 2026 through January 2028, and a $100 million retention RSU pool. Share consideration uses a 20-day VWAP collar of $33.07–$49.61; closing consideration is reduced by leakage since July 31, 2026. No board recommendation, advisor, premium, or close date was disclosed. Watch regulatory clearance, VWAP collar economics, and earnout achievability.
